#157 keeps recording when model validation, speaker preparation or input validation fails and defers speech. This test states the opposite contract: cancellation during admitted preparation joins before the lease is released. Needs a decision from the owner of #157: change the contract or restore the refusal. Passes on c66a80fd^1 and fails after #157.

Needs a decision from the owner of #157: change the contract or restore the refusal. Passes on c66a80fd^1 and fails after #157.
